former custom dataset path, fail loudly instead of being silently ignored.

post.description:
Create a standard or CI API key.

Args:
    api_key: Name and kind of API key to create.
    current_user: Authenticated owner of the new key.
    session: Database session.

Returns:
    The new API key, including its one-time plaintext value.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If CI keys are unavailable, or an active CI key exists.
    PermissionsError: If a non-admin requests a CI key.
